hooks.command: F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; git check-ignore -q "$F" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; case "$F" in "$R"/*.py) "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix --unfixable F401 --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1; "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; "$R"/*.md) "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$F" in "$R"/src/*.py) OUT=$(cd "$R" && .venv/bin/python -m mypy src/ --no-error-summary 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+/(\s|\*|$|;)|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+\*|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+\.|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+~'; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: rm -rf with dangerous target. Specify exact paths.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+push\s+(--force|-f)|git\s+push\s+origin\s+(main|master)'; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: Direct push to main or force push. Create a feature branch and PR.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$F" in /*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; D=${F%/*}; while [ -n "$D" ] && [ ! -d "$D" ]; do D=${D%/*}; done; [ "$(git -C "${D:-/}" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = main ] || exit 0; REPO=$(git -C "${D:-/}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; git -C "$REPO" check-ignore -q "$F" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; case "$F" in "$REPO"/AGENTS.md|"$REPO"/CLAUDE.md) ;; "$REPO"/*) echo '❌ BLOCKED: Cannot edit repo files on main. Allowed: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. Create a feature branch, or edit the copy in your worktree.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])git([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+([[:space:]]+[^-[:space:]][^[:space:]]*)?)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$|[;&|)])'; then R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; OUT=$(cd "$R" && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check --output-format concise . 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | tail -20 >&2; echo '❌ BLOCKED: Unformatted files. Run just fix, re-add the files you are committing, then retry.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi; exit 0

IN=$(cat); STOP_ACTIVE=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$STOP_ACTIVE" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; RESPONSE=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // empty' | tail -200); if printf '%s\n' "$RESPONSE" | grep -qiE 'TODO|FIXME|will implement later|placeholder|stub'; then echo '⚠️ Response contains incomplete markers (TODO/FIXME/placeholder). Consider finishing before stopping.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
